item.title: Contratto di ricerca: project DBA.AD001.871 - NanoBio-FARM CUP B89J25001510005 (CNR - Istituto per la Protezione Sostenibile delle Piante)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-27 23:59
Institution: CNR - Istituto per la Protezione Sostenibile delle Piante, Portici
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-02 Fisiologia vegetale

The researcher will be responsible for research activities focused on plant physiology, phenotyping, and the evaluation of biostimulant formulations—specifically, assessing the effects of innovative products based on beneficial microbial consortia, nanoparticles, and bioactive compounds on plant growth, development, and physiological responses. These activities will include the design and execution of experimental trials under controlled conditions, the analysis of seed germinability and vigor, the morpho-physiological characterization of plants using phenotyping techniques, and the assessment of the biostimulant efficacy of the treatments.

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Development and testing of cultivation and bioremediation systems based on native Porifera (sponges) within the framework of Integrated Multi-Trophic Aquaculture (IMTA) for the AVATIM project (Univ. BARI)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-27 23:55
Institution: Univ. BARI, Roma
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-03 Zoologia e antropologia

The AVATIM project aims to develop a sustainable aquaculture system based on the innovative Integrated Multi-Trophic Aquaculture (IMTA) approach. This method involves cultivating species from different trophic levels to mitigate the environmental impact of fish farming, optimize resource use, and contribute to maintaining a balanced marine ecosystem. The research focuses on the selection, characterization, and cultivation of native sponge species (Porifera) to serve as bioremediators. The project includes: 1. identifying the most suitable species through laboratory experiments; 2. evaluating their filtration and clearance capacities; 3. designing and managing a pilot-scale marine sponge…

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-19 12:00
Institution: Univ. TRENTO, Trento
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-14 Genetica

The research is part of the CGC Award project "PATHWAYS, RISK FACTORS, AND MOLECULES TO PREVENT EARLY-ONSET COLORECTAL TUMORS (PROSPECT)."
